senses.gloss: m. pl. (פחל, cmp. פַּחְדִּין a. Syr. פחלא testiculus, P. Sm. 3081) ball, bale; פ׳ של גמלים a bale, made of a net of ropes with wide meshes, containing the freight of camels.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Metsia 6:6">Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. VI, 6</cite> <he>הסל והפ׳ של ג׳ … שעשאן וכ׳</he> a basket or a bale … the meshes of which had originally been made narrow enough to hold pomegranates.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shevuot 3:8:3">Y. Shebu. III, 34ᵈ</cite> (Chald. dict.) <he>אייתון פ׳ דגמלין ומלון וכ׳</he> they brought bales and stuffed them with straw; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Nedarim 3:2:3">Y. Ned. III, beg. 37ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>פחלץ</he> (corr. acc.).—
<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 762">Yalk. Num. 762</cite> <cite ref="Q00218"><he>פולחן</he></cite> (prob. to be read: <he>פוחלין</he>).
